answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity anchors itself at a delta of verifiable attestations, where accumulated honest work shifts the balance over time. The plume of reputation rises only from sustained contribution—clones lack the thermal updraft of genuine history and stall at low altitude. The signal of trust propagates only from anchored nodes; fake identities generate only noise. An attacker must maintain N independent deltas across epochs, paying full effort per identity while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; reward remains bounded.
